title: Prison props: guard tower, perimeter wall with razor wire, cell bars, bunk, toilet, sink
summary: Prison set pieces: guard tower with lit painted windows, precast wall with razor-wire coil, barred cell door, rusty bunk with draped blankets, steel toilet and sink, bare bulb on a wire, rope.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: import { guardTower, prisonWall, cellBars, bunkBed, steelToilet, sinkUnit, hangingBulb } from '../library/module.recon.prison-props/index.js';

doc.when: Prison exteriors (wall, tower), cells, escape stories; the bulb and rope fit any underground or derelict set.
doc.avoid: An emissive room box for lit windows (reads as a flat orange block): the tower paints the room and the guard into the window texture.
gotchas: Tilting a tower (lean) pivots on its base edge: an embedded base reads as FLOATING to the checker (its rays start inside the thin ground slab).
AI references often draw a tower plumb on screen while the camera is rolled: tip it to match the picture, not physics.
The bunk's mattresses are solids; blankets/heaps/pillows are noContact.
